pick.name: Cloudflare AI Gateway
pick.what: Hosted proxy in front of any provider: analytics, caching, rate limiting, fallbacks, BYOK
pick.why: No servers to run, core features free on all plans, host-agnostic; exit cost is one base URL
pick.free_limits: Core features (analytics, caching, rate limiting) free. Legacy logs: 100,000 total on Workers Free; gateways created on/after 2026-09-24 use Workers Logs pricing. Unified Billing credits carry 5% fee; no markup on provider pricing. Guardrails billed as Workers AI inference.

alts.name: LiteLLM (self-hosted proxy + SDK)
alts.what: OpenAI-format gateway to 100+ providers with virtual keys, spend tracking, guardrails
alts.why: Right when PHI traffic must stay in your own VPC or you need per-customer keys/budgets
alts.free_limits: Self-host; core plus separate commercial-licence enterprise features
alts.maintained: litellm 1.106.5 on 2026-10-27 (per file). PyPI compromise 2026-03-24 (~10:39-16:00 UTC): 1.82.7 and 1.82.8 malicious credential stealers (1.82.8 adds litellm_init.pth); last clean 1.82.6; 1.83.0 (2026-03-30) first release via new CI/CD v2; Docker image ghcr.io/berriai/litellm unaffected. If either version was ever installed: remove litellm_init.pth, rotate all secrets, audit CI logs, block models.litellm[.]cloud and checkmarx[.]zone.

alts.name: Vercel AI Gateway
alts.why: Cleanest if the app is on Vercel with AI SDK

candidates.name: LiteLLM
candidates.verdict: Alt: self-host for PHI/virtual keys; 2026 PyPI supply-chain compromise

candidates.name: OpenRouter
candidates.verdict: Better as model source than control plane; 5.5% fee

candidates.name: Bifrost (Maxim, Go, Apache-2.0)
candidates.verdict: Fast self-host gateway; no TS SDK info seen

candidates.name: Portkey OSS gateway
candidates.verdict: Acquired by Palo Alto Networks (announced 2026-04-30, reported closed 2026-05-29) - roadmap now security-product driven

candidates.name: No gateway (AI SDK provider swap only)
candidates.verdict: Valid until multiple providers in prod

decision: A solo founder should not run a gateway server; Cloudflare AI Gateway gives caching, limits and logs free with one URL of lock-in. Switch to self-hosted LiteLLM (or Bifrost) when PHI must not transit a third-party proxy or you need per-tenant budgets.
details: Gateways see all prompts - confirm BAA/DPA before routing PHI (Cloudflare BAA status unverified).

verify.note: Cloudflare AI Gateway pricing confirmed: core features + DLP free on all plans; Legacy logs 100,000 total on Workers Free (10M/gateway on Paid); accounts whose first gateway is created on/after 2026-09-24 use Workers Logs; Unified Billing 5% fee, no provider markup; Guardrails billed as Workers AI inference. Decision sound for a solo founder.
